 CME Group Tour Championship 2026: Adjusted TV times, tee times for Round 3
 By
 Golf Channel Staff , 
 By
 Golf Channel Staff 
     Published November 20, 2026 05:00 PM 
 Twitter 
 Email
 Korda: 'Not hitting it as solid as I would like' 
 Nelly Korda shot 5-under 67 during the second round of the CME Group Tour Championship and discussed the issues she's being having with the way she's hitting the ball. 
 With the threat of inclement weather Saturday in Naples, Florida, TV times and tee times have been bumped up for Round 3 of the CME Group Tour Championship.
 Full coverage will air from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. EST on both CNBC and Golf Channel mobile . Golf Channel will simulcast the live action from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m.
 “Golf Central Pregame” will lead into coverage, beginning at 10 a.m. EST.
 A Lim Kim, currently at 15 under, holds a three-shot lead over two-time defending champion Jeeno Thitikul. Charley Hull is among a group tied for third, four back. Nelly Korda is six off the pace .
 Third-round tee times will be added when made available by the LPGA.
